title: SignalX Zero component recipe (RecipeInput)
description: The argument to @sigx/zero-kit's defineRecipe(), as plain JSON data: per-part styles for one component, resolved against that component's anatomy in the zero manifest. An AI (or any tool) can emit this JSON, wrap it in defineRecipe(...) and run `sigx zero:validate` — this schema catches structural mistakes; whether a part, state or var(--…) reference actually exists is the validator's job, because it depends on the anatomy and the token declaration.

component.description: The component scope this recipe styles (e.g. "tabs") — must match an anatomy scope in the zero manifest.

tokens.description: Component-level tokens declared on the carrier part (root, else the first part). Emitted in @layer zero.recipes, so a theme-level declaration of the same property cannot override one.

variants.description: axis → value → part → styles. The contract axes (color, size, variant) have named props; any other kebab-case axis is reachable through zero's `axes` prop. Axis names and values are written into [data-<axis>="<value>"] selectors (and lynx class names): names take the kebab-case grammar, values the wider axis-value grammar (repeated hyphens allowed).

modifiers.description: Presence-only modifiers: name → part → styles, emitted as [data-mod-<name>]. Names must be declared in tokens.modifiers. There is no defaultVariants analogue — a modifier is absent by nature, so absence already is the default.

compoundVariants.description: Styles applied when several axis values (and/or modifiers) hold at once.

match.description: axis → value, or modifier → true; every entry must hold for the styles to apply. A true entry compiles to the presence-only [data-mod-<name>].

defaultVariants.description: axis → value applied when the axis attribute is absent (CSS-only defaults, compiled to :not([data-<axis>]) selectors).

keyframes.description: name → raw keyframes body ("from { … } to { … }"), emitted as @keyframes <name> after the recipe's layer block.

css.description: Raw CSS appended verbatim at the end of this component's @layer zero.recipes block — the escape hatch for anything the typed surface can't express.

skipStates.description: part → declared states/flags intentionally left unstyled; silences the validator's coverage warning for them, and tells the state-legibility guard the state is deliberately indistinguishable from its siblings.

targets.description: Per-target sections, deep-merged over the shared recipe before that target compiles. Web-runtime-dependent declarations (var(--press-*), the raw css hatch) live in targets.web; targets.lynx supplies replacements where a dropped web spelling leaves a state illegible.

kebabToken.description: A kebab-case identifier that may start with a digit — the grammar for anything written into a [data-…] selector (scopes, parts, states, axis and modifier names); axis VALUES take the wider axisValue grammar.

cssProps.description: CSS declarations: property → value. Property names may be camelCase (kebab-cased at compile time) or custom properties (--x, kept verbatim); numbers are emitted as-is, so use them only for unitless values.

partStyles.description: Styles for one part. `at` maps a condition — a declared breakpoint name, a built-in (reduced-motion, hover-none, prefers-dark, forced-colors, print, starting-style) or a raw "@…" prelude — to this same shape, recursively; nesting composes the at-rules.

states.description: state/flag/interaction name → declarations. Names resolve through the anatomy: machine states → [data-state="…"], flags → [data-…], interactions → real pseudo-classes. An empty object marks a state as deliberately covered without emitting CSS.

selectors.description: Nested selectors; `&` is the part selector (a key without `&` is treated as a descendant).

propertyNames.description: A declared breakpoint or built-in condition (kebab-case), or a raw at-rule prelude starting with @.

partsRecord.description: part name → styles. Part names must exist in the component's anatomy — the compiler and validator both fail on an unknown part.

targetOverride.description: One target's override — the styling surface only; identity (component, defaultVariants) and coverage claims stay shared.

axisValue.description: An axis VALUE: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, repeated hyphens included (Carbon's danger--tertiary) — what a quoted [data-…="…"] attribute selector, a single-quoted literal union in register.d.ts and an unescaped lynx class name (zx-a-<axis>-<value>) all carry verbatim. Wider than the kebab-case grammar names take; still no %, ., quotes, backslashes, whitespace or uppercase.
